project: Wird - Quran, Hadith & Dua memorization app

architecture.backend: None. Offline-first, no accounts, no server DB. Content packs fetched as static files.
architecture.layers: lib/core (logic, never imports features) / lib/features (screens) / lib/shared (UI kit)
architecture.l10n: 7 locales en ar ur hi bn ml fil; ARB in lib/l10n; add via tool/apply_l10n_batch.py then flutter gen-l10n

data_sources.translations: fawazahmed0 quran-api editions, allowlist tool/editions_allowlist.json (vetted: King Fahd / IslamHouse)
data_sources.hadith: fawazahmed0 hadith-api via jsDelivr; books bukhari muslim abudawud tirmidhi nasai ibnmajah malik + bundled Nawawi 40; ur/bn text upstream

content_rules: Never type Quran or hadith text from memory; never 'fix' sourced text.
Never machine-translate hadith or duas. hi/ml/fil hadith stay English with a note.
Summaries neutral, Ahlus Sunnah / Salaf standard.
traps: flutter not on PowerShell PATH: use C:\flutter\bin\flutter.bat
After adding a dependency run flutter pub get in PowerShell too before APK build (pub cache split)
sentry_flutter needs minSdk 26: use plain-Dart sentry package
compute() hangs widget tests: _offThread runs inline under 200 KB
Emulator deep links: am start -n pkg/.MainActivity -d "'url'" with MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1
just_audio_background allows one player app-wide; Wird has several
open_gaps: Audit P0: WQA-004, WQA-024, WQA-014 (see docs/audit/00-master-report.md)
Meaning search + read-along need model trial and Waleed's recordings
Data-sources screen shows raw dev notes; reciter/palette names not localized
Not verified on a real phone or deployed PWA

audit.rule: Log only; fixes need Waleed's approval; religious text is never altered

learnings.note: Upstream hadith-api has empty entries (203 Muslim, 86 Nasai) and decimal numbers like 402.2; drop empties, show decimal label.
Vercel project production domain became wird-ebon.vercel.app; wird-alpha.vercel.app had to be re-added under Domains. Supabase free project pauses when idle - app falls back to jsDelivr.
